tools.name: get_test_questions
tools.description: The 62 public-domain IPIP statements of the free 64 Types personality test (Big Five + HEXACO Honesty-Humility), with the 1-5 answer scale. Ask the user each one, then call score_test.

tools.name: score_test
tools.description: Score the user's answers to get their 64 Types type (e.g. INTJ-CM), trait percentiles against open norms (~20,000 people), borderline letters, a plain-language summary and a shareable result link.

tools.name: get_type_profile
tools.description: Research-backed profile of a type: a 4-letter base (INTJ) with its 4 variants, or a full 64 Types code (INTJ-CM) with traits, strengths, watch-outs, career, love and growth notes and a link.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: The 16 base types and 4 variants with names, taglines and links.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What is free (the test, result and every type profile) and the optional paid reports with prices and checkout links.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Checkout link for one paid product, to hand to the user. They pay on Lemon Squeezy; the reply says what happens after payment.
